notes.title: Steam Achievements and More in Update 1.7!
notes.content: [p]Update 1.7 for [i]Motherboard Under Attack[/i] has arrived with exciting new features![/p][p]You can now unlock [b]Steam achievements[/b] while defending your motherboard from relentless waves of digital viruses.[/p][p]We’ve also optimized performance and adjusted levels to make challenges more balanced and fun.[/p][p]Grab your solder, place your towers, and prove you’re the true master of electronic defense![/p]

notes.title: Explore the unique soundtrack of "Motherboard Under Attack"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43016084/d0b6f3466eba4a6a08b640d99da6e61ebda8da70.jpg[/img]

Enter the world of "Motherboard Under Attack" not just to defend your processor from electronic boards, but also to immerse yourself in a unique sonic experience. This exclusive digital soundtrack isn't merely background music; it's the pulsating beat driving every strategic solder and move to repel malicious viruses threatening your CPU.

Experience the unique fusion of pulsating electronica and dynamic melodies that perfectly complement the frenetic action and intense strategy defining "Motherboard Under Attack".

Prepare to dive into an auditory experience that not only accompanies but enhances every moment of your mission to safeguard your system's digital core. The soundtrack for "Motherboard Under Attack" is now available on Steam. Let yourself be carried away by the rhythm of the digital battle and immerse yourself in the infectious energy of this soundtrack tailored for true technology defenders.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2847900/Motherboard_Under_Attack_Soundtrack/
